tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Returns an upload_id and a one-day upload link for a .jar, .war or .class file, plus a curl command that uploads the file from disk.

tools.name: list_classes
tools.description: Lists the .class entries in an uploaded .jar/.war. Use filter to search by package or class name.

tools.name: decompile_class
tools.description: Decompiles one class to Java source. Give upload_id (+ class_path for a class inside a JAR), or class_base64 for a small .class file.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Shows the plan this connection is on and how many class decompiles are left this hour.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url, decompile_class · Public sink: get_upload_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url, decompile_class · Public sink: get_upload_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
